instruction:
打开终端（macOS: Terminal；Linux: GNOME Terminal），在终端里输入并执行这条命令：

echo benchmark-done > ~/bench-work/terminal.txt

确认命令执行完成（出现新的提示符）。

本任务仅允许 GUI 工具操作；不得调用 shell 或文件工具读取答案或完成任务。

content: click: pass x/y as integers (0-1000 normalized) or a bbox [x1,y1,x2,y2] in x

turn_messages.content: 我将打开 macOS 终端并执行指定的命令。让我先启动 Terminal 应用。

turn_messages.name: launch_app
turn_messages.content: Launched 'Terminal' and brought it to the foreground.

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
我可以看到 Terminal 已经打开，但它正在询问是否要更新 oh-my-zsh。我需要先回答这个问题（按 'n' 表示不更新），然后才能输入命令。

让我先按 'n' 跳过更新提示：

turn_messages.name: type_text
turn_messages.content:
Typed: 'n'
Input method: keystroke. Input dispatched; application effect not verified.
我需要按 Enter 来确认这个选择，然后等待提示符出现：

turn_messages.name: key_press
turn_messages.content: Pressed: enter
让我等待一下，然后截图查看终端状态：

turn_messages.name: wait
turn_messages.content: tool 'wait' is not available to this agent. Available tools: ['click', 'computer_batch', 'drag', 'hold_key', 'key_press', 'launch_app', 'mouse_down', 'mouse_move', 'mouse_up', 'screenshot', 'scroll', 'type_text']
让我截图查看当前终端状态：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
终端已经就绪，我可以看到命令提示符 `>` 在等待输入。现在我需要点击终端窗口以确保焦点在终端上，然后输入并执行命令。

让我先点击终端窗口的输入区域：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: click: pass x/y as integers (0-1000 normalized) or a bbox [x1,y1,x2,y2] in x
我需要修正坐标格式。让我点击终端窗口的正确位置：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (725, 460) → pixel (1392, 496), clicks=1
现在终端应该有焦点了。让我输入命令并执行：

turn_messages.name: type_text
turn_messages.content:
Typed: 'echo benchmark-done > ~/bench-work/terminal.txt'
Input method: clipboard_paste. Input dispatched; application effect not verified.
命令已输入。现在按 Enter 执行：

turn_messages.name: key_press
turn_messages.content: Pressed: enter
让我截图确认命令执行完成并出现新的提示符：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
任务已成功完成！从截图中可以确认：

1. **命令已执行**：终端中显示了 `echo benchmark-done > ~/bench-work/terminal.txt` 这条命令
2. **新提示符已出现**：命令执行后，终端返回了新的命令提示符 `>`（最后一行显示 `zbcjackson ~ v3.12.3(#backend) base 12:26 >`），表明命令已成功执行完毕

该命令已将字符串 `benchmark-done` 写入到 `~/bench-work/terminal.txt` 文件中。
